Name: First Prince Hanse Davion
Details: Hanse Adriaan Davion has been the First Prince of the Federated Suns since the death of ihs brother Ian in 3013. Hanse was the second child of Prince Andrew Davion and his wife Jennifer Campbell. Hanse Davion is known by his nickname of 'The Fox' for his shrewd and cunning military and political strategies. Most famoulsy, he had allied the Federated Suns with the Lyran commonwealth through his marraige to Melissa Steiner in 3028.
